name: Spike Electric Controls
old_description: Spike Electric designs and manufactures low- and medium-voltage switchgear, including arc-resistant models. Custom switchgear features include arc flash mitigation, reinforced enclosures, cycloaliphatic insulation and copper-chrome contacts.
about:
Spike Electric Controls was founded in 1965 in Houston, Texas, as an American electrical equipment manufacturer. The company designs and builds power distribution and control systems for critical infrastructure.

The company engineers and manufactures low- and medium-voltage switchgear, gas-insulated switchgear, and custom power distribution systems. Its vertically integrated operations span electrical engineering, precision machining, forming, welding, finishing, assembly, and in-house testing, supported by a workforce of 500 to 999 employees.

Spike serves commercial, industrial, and utility sectors, with notable projects including power infrastructure for Google data centers, hazardous-location switchracks for Marathon Petroleum, fast-track automatic transfer switch systems for Milton Caterpillar, and custom breaker cells for the Downtown Houston Tunnel installation.

Founded on a stewardship philosophy, Spike emphasizes accountability by keeping engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, and post-delivery support under one roof, aiming to reduce handoffs and accelerate delivery for mission-critical applications.
